metaDescription: Order custom black lanyards for your team or event. Durable, professional, and fully customizable. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Black lanyards offer a professional, neutral base that complements any logo or ID badge color. Whether you need 3/8" knit-in lanyards for lightweight badges or 1" woven styles for heavy access cards, black works for every industry. The dark color hides daily wear and tear, making them ideal for long-term use in schools, offices, or factories. Add your imprint with screen printing, dye sublimation, or woven text for a crisp, lasting look.
heroAltText: Custom black lanyards with printed logos and metal clips, ideal for ID badges and event credentials.
